prompt: refactor the api to use sqlalchemy
expected_output: Creates services/yolo/models.py containing Base, PredictionSession(Base), and DetectionObject(Base). Creates services/yolo/db.py containing create_engine, SessionLocal, get_db(), and SQLite/PostgreSQL dual-backend config via DB_BACKEND env var. Updates app.py to import from models and db, adds Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine) at module level, removes all ORM class definitions, removes create_engine/SessionLocal/get_db/init_db from app.py, imports ORM models with ORM aliases. Creates tests/conftest.py with db_session and client fixtures using dependency_overrides. Rewrites all test files to use conftest fixtures instead of init_db or app.DB_PATH. All existing endpoints remain at identical paths, status codes, and response shapes. pytest tests/ exits with code 0.

prompt: add a UserFeedback table to track user ratings per prediction
expected_output: Adds a new UserFeedback class to services/yolo/models.py inheriting from Base. The class has __tablename__ = 'user_feedback', an Integer primary key id, a String prediction_uid column with a ForeignKey to prediction_sessions.uid, an Integer rating column, and a DateTime created_at column. Does not modify any existing model, endpoint, or response shape. Does not contain CREATE TABLE SQL anywhere. Base.metadata.create_all in app.py creates the table at startup. pytest tests/ exits with code 0.

prompt: add an endpoint GET /predictions/recent that returns the 10 most recent prediction sessions
expected_output: Adds a GET /predictions/recent endpoint to app.py. The handler accepts db: Session = Depends(get_db), queries PredictionSessionORM ordered by timestamp descending, limits to 10 results, and returns a JSON list where each item contains at minimum uid and timestamp. Uses no raw SQL. Does not modify any existing endpoint. Adds at least one test using conftest.py fixtures that verifies the response is a list with HTTP 200. pytest tests/ exits with code 0.
assertions: services/yolo/app.py contains 'Depends(get_db)' in the new endpoint
A test file asserts response.status_code == 200 for GET /predictions/recent
The response is a list with at most 10 items
